description: Get the path and existence status of a periodic note (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, or yearly) for a given date. Reads folder/format config from .obsidian/daily-notes.json (daily) or the periodic-notes plugin data.json. Optionally creates the note from the configured template if it is missing.

createIfMissing.description: Create the note from the configured template if it does not exist. Default false.

date.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today when omitted.

name: get_periodic_note
